<div class="card-body">
'''Black 2''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[{{{subtype_link}}}|Starfighter: TIE/LN]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ブラック２</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットを１名乗せられる。戦闘力と回避値を使うためには、パイロットが乗っていなければならない。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ＤＳ－６１－２の操縦するタイ・ファイター。コクピットには、２７個の“炎”の撃墜マークが描かれている。操縦桿には、ミゼルの幼い息子、レジュリのホロが飾ってある。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Black 2.

'''Card text:''' May carry one pilot. A pilot must be aboard to use power and maneuver.

'''Lore:''' A TIE fighter piloted by DS-61-2. Its cockpit bears 27 flame-shaped kill marks. A holo of Mithel's young son, Rejlii, adorns the control stick.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card explicitly requires a pilot to use power and maneuver; the English card face shown alongside it states only that it may add one pilot. The English lore says each flame represents a Rebel kill, a detail not stated in the Japanese lore.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Black 2]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=31s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 0:31.</ref>
